intro.data: Two queries read a record: its billing country and its shipping country. The equalizer is the sub-set of records where the two AGREE. The tray holds inclusions and queries; bring the right pieces onto the board and wire the matching set through to the agreed country. One inclusion lands in the matching set; the other lands on a record where billing and shipping differ, so the queries disagree and miss the agreed answer. Leave the wrong inclusion in the tray.
intro.alchemy: Two assays read a material: one by fire, one by acid. The equalizer is the batch on which the two AGREE. The tray holds inclusions and assays; bring the right pieces onto the board and wire the matching batch through to the agreed reading. One inclusion lands in the matching batch; the other lands where the assays differ. Leave the wrong inclusion in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: Two readings divine an essence: one by star, one by flame. The equalizer is the part on which the two AGREE. The tray holds inclusions and readings; bring the right pieces onto the board and wire the matching part through to the agreed sign. One inclusion lands in the matching part; the other where the readings differ. Leave the wrong inclusion in the tray.
intro.abstract: For parallel f, g : A → B, the equalizer is the sub-object where f and g agree; its inclusion e : E → A picks out exactly those elements. From the tray bring e and either f or g, and wire E → A → B so the value reaches f(a)=g(a)=DE. A non-equalizing inclusion lands where f ≠ g, so the two readings split (f(a)=DE, g(a)=FR); leave it in the tray.

goal.data: Bring the right inclusion and a query from the tray and wire the matching set to the agreed country (where billing = shipping).
goal.alchemy: Bring the right inclusion and an assay from the tray and wire the matching batch to the agreed reading.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the right inclusion and a reading from the tray and wire the matching part to the agreed sign.
goal.abstract: Bring e and f (or g) from the tray and wire E → A → B to reach the value where f and g agree.

f : A → B: on an equalizer element gives f(a)=DE; on a mismatch gives the billing value DE
g : A → B: on an equalizer element gives g(a)=DE (agrees with f); on a mismatch gives the shipping value FR

afterSuccess.data: You included a record from the matching set, and BOTH queries returned the same country — that's the whole point of the equalizer: it's exactly the sub-object where the two parallel arrows agree (f∘e = g∘e). The mismatched inclusion landed where billing and shipping differ, so neither query reached the agreed answer.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You included a sample from the matching batch, and BOTH assays agreed — the equalizer is exactly where the two parallel arrows agree (f∘e = g∘e). The mismatched inclusion landed where they differ.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You included a mote from the matching part, and BOTH readings agreed — the equalizer is exactly where the two parallel arrows agree (f∘e = g∘e). The mismatched inclusion landed where they differ.
afterSuccess.abstract: f∘e = g∘e: the equalizer inclusion lands precisely where f and g coincide, so either composite gives the same value. An inclusion missing the equalizer breaks the agreement.

reveal.summary: The equalizer of parallel f, g : A → B is the sub-object e : E → A picking out exactly where f and g agree, with f∘e = g∘e. It is the limit of the parallel pair — the universal 'where they agree'.
